scopeCuts: Starting deck is 7 Gold + 3 Dagger (product scope); the physical base game uses 7 Gold + 1 Ruby + 1 Dagger + 1 Shortsword.
Market pool uses 51 real base-game card names / 84 copies rather than the full 80-card market; Fire Gem, hero decks, guard keyword and expansions are not included.
Card costs and ability numbers are adapted to this engine and documented as such; they are not a verbatim reproduction of every printed card.
No player elimination beyond the single 2-player duel; no campaign or dungeon co-op mode.
